cells.words: standing still, at ease: weight even on both feet a little apart, both arms hanging loose at the sides, hands EMPTY, head level, looking straight ahead
cells.view_words: head on: the figure faces the camera straight on; the face is fully visible; its RIGHT (red) side is on the viewer's LEFT and its LEFT (blue) side on the viewer's RIGHT

cells.words: standing still, at ease: weight even on both feet a little apart, both arms hanging loose at the sides, hands EMPTY, head level, looking straight ahead

cells.words: standing still, at ease: weight even on both feet a little apart, both arms hanging loose at the sides, hands EMPTY, head level, looking straight ahead
cells.view_words: side on, facing the viewer's LEFT: a pure profile; the figure's LEFT (blue) side is toward the camera and its RIGHT (red) limbs are mostly hidden behind; the nose points left
